name: cargo-nextest
why: Test runner used by CI. Faster than `cargo test`, runs each test in its own process (which matters here: the file-index tests build real Tantivy indexes in temp dirs), and gives per-test timing plus retries. Note it does NOT run doctests, so pair it with `cargo test --doc`.

name: cargo-release
why: Drives the release: bumps all four crates in lockstep, dates the CHANGELOG, and pushes the single `v{version}` tag that .github/workflows/release.yml triggers on. Configured by release.toml and pore-bin/release.toml.

name: typos
why: Spell-checks source and prose; run as a CI job. Configured by typos.toml, which excludes docs/superpowers/plans/*.txt because those are captured diff artifacts and correcting them would falsify the record.
